activities.tip: 워크숍 탭에서 챌린지 목록 확인. 대부분 7~8월 마감 예상 — 서둘러야 함.
activities.tip_en: Check the workshop tab for challenges. Most close Jul-Aug; hurry.

activities.name: ICLR 2027
activities.prize_en: Accepted paper = top DL career credential
activities.description: 딥러닝 특화 최상위 학회. Foundation Model·생성형 AI·강화학습 분야 강함.
activities.description_en: Top conference focused on deep learning: foundation models, generative AI, RL.
activities.tip: 워크숍 논문은 경쟁률 낮음 — 입문 논문 발표로 활용 권장.
activities.tip_en: Workshop papers are less competitive; good for a first publication.
activities.schedule_note_en: Paper deadline expected Sep-Oct 2026 · conference spring 2027

activities.name: Grand Challenge (의료 AI 플랫폼)
activities.prize_en: €100-€1,000+ per challenge
activities.description: 세계 최대 의료 AI 챌린지 플랫폼. 병리·MRI·CT·내시경·로보틱스 전 분야 300+ 활성 챌린지.
activities.description_en: World's largest medical AI challenge platform. 300+ active challenges across pathology, MRI, CT, endoscopy, robotics.
activities.tip: Active Challenges 필터로 탐색. 희소성 높아 취업 시 강력한 차별화.
activities.tip_en: Browse with the Active Challenges filter. Rare experience, strong differentiation for jobs.
activities.schedule_note_en: 300+ active challenges at all times

activities.name: MICCAI 2026 Challenges
activities.prize_en: Winning teams present at the conference
activities.description: 의료 영상 컴퓨팅 세계 1위 학회. 매년 35+ 챌린지. 챌린지 참가 + 논문 = 학술·실무 동시 경력.
activities.description_en: The #1 conference in medical image computing. 35+ challenges yearly. Challenge plus paper builds academic and practical experience together.
activities.tip: grand-challenge.org에서 MICCAI 2026 필터 검색. 7~9월 마감 챌린지 즉시 검토.
activities.tip_en: Filter for MICCAI 2026 on grand-challenge.org. Review challenges closing Jul-Sep now.

activities.name: AMIA 2026 Public Challenge
activities.prize_en: Academic credit · Kaggle medals
activities.description: AMIA(미국 의료정보학회) 주관 Kaggle 챌린지. 의료 NLP·임상 정보 추출.
activities.description_en: Kaggle challenge by AMIA (American Medical Informatics Association). Medical NLP and clinical information extraction.
activities.tip: 07.26 마감됨. 유사 의료 AI 챌린지는 grand-challenge.org에서 탐색.
activities.tip_en: Closed Jul 26. Explore similar medical AI challenges on grand-challenge.org.

activities.name: Codeforces / AtCoder (상시)
activities.prize_en: Rating · prizes in some sponsored rounds
activities.description: CF Expert(1600+), AtCoder Green(800+) = 국내 코딩 테스트 통과 기준. CF 1900+ = 빅테크 직결.
activities.description_en: CF Expert (1600+) or AtCoder Green (800+) roughly equals passing Korean coding tests. CF 1900+ maps to big tech.
activities.tip: CF 주 1~3회, AtCoder ABC 격주 토 21:00 KST. BOJ 병행, 매주 꾸준함이 핵심.
activities.tip_en: CF 1-3 rounds weekly, AtCoder ABC biweekly Sat 21:00 KST. Pair with BOJ; weekly consistency is key.
activities.schedule_note_en: 1-3 rounds every week

activities.name: ICPC Korea 2026
activities.prize_en: Medals · World Finals qualification
activities.description: 세계 최대 대학생 알고리즘 대회. 세계 대회 진출 = 빅테크 서류 통과 보장 수준.
activities.description_en: The largest university algorithm contest. Reaching the World Finals virtually guarantees big-tech resume screening.
activities.tip: BOJ 플래티넘 이상 목표로 준비. 팀원 3인 미리 구성. 팀 등록 8~9월.
activities.tip_en: Aim for BOJ Platinum or above. Form your team of 3 early. Registration Aug-Sep.
activities.schedule_note: 팀 등록 기간 미공개(TBA) · 예년 패턴 8~9월
activities.schedule_note_en: Team registration window TBA; past pattern Aug-Sep

activities.name: SCPC 2026 (삼성 프로그래밍 챌린지)
activities.prize_en: AI challenge total 70M KRW · 1st place 20M KRW
activities.description: 삼성리서치 주관 12년 역사. 올해부터 AI Agent 챌린지 트랙 신설. 이번 회차 신규 참가 불가.
activities.description_en: By Samsung Research, 12-year history. New AI Agent track this year. No new entries this round.
activities.tip: SCPC 2027은 2027년 6월 모집 예상. AI Agent + 알고리즘 실력 준비.
activities.tip_en: SCPC 2027 recruiting expected Jun 2027. Build AI-agent and algorithm skills.

activities.name: Meta Hacker Cup 2026
activities.prize_en: 1st place $20,000 · finals at Meta HQ
activities.description: Meta 주관, ICPC와 함께 알고리즘 대회 최고 권위. 연 1회.
activities.description_en: By Meta. With ICPC, one of the most prestigious algorithm contests. Once a year.
activities.tip: 가을(10월경) 공지 예상 — 공지 즉시 등록. Meta 취업 직결.
activities.tip_en: Announcement expected around October; register immediately. Direct line to Meta hiring.
activities.schedule_note: 2026 일정 미발표 · 최근 패턴 기준 10~11월 예상 (2025: 예선 10월)
activities.schedule_note_en: 2026 schedule TBA; recent pattern suggests Oct-Nov (2025 qualifiers were in October)

activities.name: KT 에이블스쿨 10기 (AIVLE School)
activities.prize_en: Free (MOEL funded) · KT hiring preference
activities.description: KT + 고용노동부. AI 개발자 / DX 컨설턴트 2개 트랙, 6개월 온라인 840시간. 4년제 6학기 이상.
activities.description_en: KT with Ministry of Employment and Labor. Two tracks: AI developer / DX consultant. 6 months online, 840 hours. Requires 6+ semesters at a 4-year university.
activities.tip: 접수 마감 08.10 — 지금 지원 가능! 온라인이라 지역 무관.
activities.tip_en: Applications close Aug 10; you can apply right now. Online, so location doesn't matter.

activities.description_en: Run by Samsung Electronics. 12 months (6 basic + 6 advanced), 5 campuses nationwide. Strengthened AI curriculum (SSAFY 2.0).
activities.tip: 10~11월 모집 예상. PS(코딩테스트) + 자소서 지금부터 준비. 비전공자 Java반 별도.
activities.tip_en: Recruiting expected Oct-Nov. Prepare coding tests and essays now. Separate Java track for non-majors.
activities.schedule_note: 공식 사이트에 '17기 모집안내' 메뉴 확인 · 세부 일정 미공개, 예년 패턴 10~11월 모집 → 2027.01 입과

activities.prize: 무료 · 수료 후 현대차·기아 최종 면접
activities.prize_en: Free · final interview at Hyundai/Kia after completion
activities.description: 현대차·기아 공동 운영, 8주(이론 4+프로젝트 4). 2026년 AI 퍼스트로 개편. 수료 후 최종 면접 → 입사.

activities.tip_en: Learn React and Spring Boot beforehand. Best path for mobility software.
activities.schedule_note: 8기 교육 진행 중 (7.1~8.31) · 9기 모집 미공고, 예년 패턴 10~11월 예상
activities.schedule_note_en: 8th cohort in training (Jul 1-Aug 31); 9th not announced, expected Oct-Nov per past pattern

activities.schedule_note_en: Official notice: Web/Mobile and AI Tech tracks will not run in 2026; future undecided

activities.prize_en: Free · gaming industry hiring links

activities.schedule_note_en: 13th (H2 2026) recruited Jun 8-Jul 5; next intake expected late 2026 to early 2027

activities.prize_en: Free · Woowa Brothers hiring preference
activities.description: 우아한형제들 운영. 백엔드/프론트/안드로이드, 10개월. 페어 프로그래밍·코드 리뷰 중심.

activities.tip: 프리코스(5주) 통과 후 선발. 9~10월 모집 예상 — Java/JS 기본기 지금 다질 것.
activities.tip_en: Selection after a 5-week precourse. Recruiting expected Sep-Oct; solidify Java/JS basics now.
activities.schedule_note: 9기 미공고 · 예년 패턴 9월 말 서류 접수 → 10월 프리코스 (8기: 9.29 서류 시작)
activities.schedule_note_en: 9th not announced; past pattern: applications late Sep, precourse in Oct (8th began Sep 29)

activities.tip_en: Watch per-campus member recruiting in September. Community hub: campus.gdg.kr
activities.schedule_note_en: Member recruiting Sep-Oct per campus; organizer applications Mar-Jun globally

activities.description_en: MSIT's AI/SW fellowship (2-month prep + 6-month main). Students or unemployed, any major. 300 seats Seoul + 150 Busan.
activities.tip: 17기는 1~3월 모집 완료. 18기 2027년 1~2월 예상 — 코딩테스트 지금부터 준비.
activities.tip_en: 17th recruited Jan-Mar. 18th expected Jan-Feb 2027; start preparing for the coding test now.

activities.description: 국내 최대 AI/ML 비영리 오픈 커뮤니티 (멤버 6,300+, 누적 프로젝트 292개). Agentic AI·Physical AI 중심. 디스코드 상시 참여, 시즌제 러너(스터디원)·빌더(리더) 모집.
activities.description_en: Korea's largest nonprofit open AI/ML community (6,300+ members, 292 projects). Focused on agentic and physical AI. Discord open anytime; seasonal runner/builder recruiting.
activities.tip: 디스코드는 지금 바로 가입 가능. 다음 시즌 러너 모집은 예년 패턴상 8월 말~9월 초 — 공지 주시.
activities.tip_en: Join the Discord anytime. Next-season runner recruiting usually opens late Aug-early Sep; watch for the notice.

activities.schedule_note_en: Next-season runner recruiting expected Aug-Sep 2026 (Season 11 closed Sep 4); PseudoCon 2026 on Jul 25

activities.prize_en: Total 80M KRW (grand 50M) + direct to NHN final interview
activities.description: NHN 주최 게임×AI 해커톤. 사전 과제(플레이 가능한 게임 빌드 + AI 활용 기술 문서) 제출, 10팀 본선(판교). 문체부·콘진원 후원.
activities.description_en: NHN's game-and-AI hackathon. Submit a playable game build plus an AI-usage tech doc; 10 teams reach the Pangyo finals. Backed by MCST and KOCCA.
activities.tip: 접수 마감 08.10. 만 19세 이상, 개인 또는 3인 이하 팀.
activities.tip_en: Applications close Aug 10. Age 19+, solo or teams up to 3.

activities.prize: 교육비 무료 + 월 60만 원 훈련수당 + 자격증 취득 축하금
activities.prize_en: Free tuition + 600K KRW monthly stipend + certification bonus
activities.description: 신한금융 K-뉴딜 아카데미의 금융IT·AI 에이전트 개발 과정. 472시간(9.1~11.27, 서울 을지로), 40명. 전공·코딩 경험 무관.
activities.description_en: Shinhan Financial's K-New Deal Academy: finance IT and AI-agent development, 472 hours (Sep 1-Nov 27, Euljiro Seoul), 40 seats. No major or coding experience required.
activities.tip: 접수 마감 08.04 — 일주일 안 남음. 만 15~34세 미취업 청년 대상 (재학생·재직자 제외).
activities.tip_en: Applications close Aug 4, under a week away. Unemployed youth aged 15-34 (students and employees excluded).

activities.name: 제3회 풍력발전량 예측 AI 경진대회 (BARAM)
activities.prize_en: Total 20M KRW
activities.description: GS E&R 주최, DACON 운영. 실제 풍력발전 운영 데이터 + 기상예보 기반 발전량 예측. 진행 중이며 지금 참가 가능.
activities.description_en: Hosted by GS E&R on DACON: forecast wind power output from real plant data and weather forecasts. Running now and joinable.
activities.tip: 제출 마감 08.14 — 시계열 예측 포트폴리오에 적합.
activities.tip_en: Submissions close Aug 14. Good for a time-series forecasting portfolio.

activities.name: SKT 모두의 Promp.T 공모전
activities.prize_en: ~10M KRW total (2 grand prizes, ~400 participation prizes)
activities.description: SKT 주최. Life AX / Work AX 부문에 자신만의 AI 프롬프트와 활용 사례 제출. 만 14세 이상 누구나 — 진입장벽 낮은 라이트 공모전.
activities.description_en: By SKT: submit your own AI prompts and use cases in Life AX / Work AX tracks. Age 14+, very low barrier to entry.
activities.tip: 접수 08.10 마감. 첫 공모전 경험용으로 부담 없음.
activities.tip_en: Closes Aug 10. A low-stakes first contest experience.

activities.name: 2026 데이터+AI 크리에이터 캠프
activities.prize: 부문별 시상 · 12월 클라우드·데이터 진흥주간 통합 시상
activities.prize_en: Awards per division at December's Cloud & Data Week ceremony
activities.description: 과기정통부 '데이터+AI 혁신 챌린지' 통합 브랜드의 교육 연계 경진. 고등학생·대학생 4~5인 팀. 발대식 8.20, 최종 제출 11.25.
activities.description_en: Education-linked contest under MSIT's unified 'Data+AI Innovation Challenge' brand. Teams of 4-5 high school or university students. Kickoff Aug 20, final submission Nov 25.
activities.tip: 접수 마감(7.30). 참가팀은 8.20 발대식, 최종 제출 11.25.
activities.tip_en: Applications closed Jul 30. Participants: kickoff Aug 20, final submission Nov 25.

activities.prize_en: Total 8.5M KRW (grand prize 3M each for student/general divisions)
activities.description: 과기정통부·NIPA·한국AI스마트홈산업협회 주관. Matter 표준 기반 스마트홈 프로토타입 개발. 1~3인 팀, Nordic 개발킷 무료 제공, Matter 교육 포함.
activities.description_en: By MSIT, NIPA, and the Korea AI Smart Home Industry Association. Build Matter-standard smart home prototypes. Teams of 1-3; free Nordic devkits and Matter training included.
activities.tip: 접수 8.3 시작 ~ 9.11 18:00 마감 (이메일 접수). 임베디드·IoT 포트폴리오에 적합.
activities.tip_en: Applications Aug 3 to Sep 11 18:00 via email. Great for embedded/IoT portfolios.

activities.schedule_note_en: Document prelims mid-Sep; live finals expected Oct; awards early Nov

activities.prize_en: Total 11.23M KRW + full-time hiring links
activities.description: 씽크포비엘 주최 AI 신뢰성 검증 해커톤 2회차. 3개월 장기 트랙 (OT 9월 → 예선 10월 → 본선 11월). 대학생 대상.
activities.description_en: 2nd AI trustworthiness hackathon by ThinkforBL. Three-month track (OT Sep, prelims Oct, finals Nov). For university students.
activities.tip: 접수 8.21 마감. AI 안전·검증 분야 — 흔치 않은 주제라 차별화됨.
activities.tip_en: Applications close Aug 21. AI safety/verification is a rare, differentiating topic.
activities.schedule_note: OT 9월 초 · 예선 10월 중순 · 본선 11월 하순 예상
activities.schedule_note_en: OT early Sep; prelims mid-Oct; finals late Nov expected

activities.tip: 접수 8.3 마감 — 사흘 남음. 접수는 링커리어 공고 내 구글폼.
activities.tip_en: Applications close Aug 3, three days away. Apply via the Google Form in the Linkareer listing.

activities.name_en: AI Agent Security: Multi-Step Tool Attacks (Kaggle)
activities.description: OpenAI·Google·IEEE 공동 주관. 툴을 사용하는 AI 에이전트의 재현 가능한 멀티스텝 실패를 찾는 공격 알고리즘 개발. 전 세계 누구나.
activities.description_en: Co-hosted by OpenAI, Google, and IEEE: build attack algorithms that find reproducible multi-step failures in tool-using AI agents. Open worldwide.
activities.tip: Entry 마감 8.25. AI 안전 × 보안 교차 주제 — 희소성 높은 포트폴리오.
activities.tip_en: Entry deadline Aug 25. AI safety times security is a rare portfolio topic.
